hooks.command: { mkdir -p "${HOME}/.claude/rules"; for f in "${HOME}/.claude/rules"/skillz-*.md; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; b=${f##*/}; [ -e "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/rules/${b#skillz-}" ] || rm -f "$f"; done; set -- "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/rules/*.md; [ -e "$1" ] && for f in "$@"; do cp -f "$f" "${HOME}/.claude/rules/skillz-$(basename "$f")"; done; } >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
